description: This file contains handlers and utilities for managing speech-to-text (STT) services within a webview context, including starting, stopping, device management, and code glossary extraction.

classes.name: VisibleCodeGlossary
classes.description: A class that captures visible code and formats it into a glossary prompt for use during speech recognition sessions.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an STTService instance associated with a given ClineProvider.

methods.name: handleSTTStart
methods.description: Handles the command to start speech-to-text processing, including API key retrieval and service initiation.

methods.name: handleSTTStop
methods.description: Handles the command to stop speech-to-text processing.

methods.name: handleSTTCancel
methods.description: Handles the command to cancel ongoing speech-to-text processing.

methods.name: handleSTTSelectDevice
methods.description: Selects a microphone device for speech recognition.

methods.name: handleSTTCheckAvailability
methods.description: Checks if speech-to-text functionality is available.

methods.name: handleSTTCommand
methods.description: Unified handler for various STT commands.

methods.name: getGlossary
methods.description: Generates a code glossary prompt based on visible code.
